title: Graphene bilayer — carbon materials
description: This is a Signature-authored nanomaterial study. The graphene bilayer is a carbon nanomaterial with electronic: tunable bandgap under electric field; thickness: 0.69 nm. Fabrication route: chemical vapor deposition. The nanoscale runs 1–100 nm; a nanometer is a billionth of a meter — about 100,000 times smaller than a human hair’s width.
